name: agent-websearch-eval
description: Checks outside input with Jev before Claude reads it: web search and web fetch results, MCP tool results, and curl, wget and gh output. Warns Claude and you when the text tries to change Claude's behaviour without your consent.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key from console.typesafe.ai. Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

mode.title: Action on a flagged result
mode.description: warn: Claude gets the result and a warning. redact: the flagged passages are removed first, and Claude gets a warning.

flag_at.title: Flag threshold
flag_at.description: Jev score from 0 to 1 at which a result is flagged. A lower value catches more and gives more false alarms.
